source: Things to do in Raleigh this Weekend! — Thingstodo919

events.name: First Friday
events.tagline: Downtown Raleigh’s monthly arts crawl brings galleries, live music, markets, and special events together across the city center.
events.description: First Friday is a monthly Downtown Raleigh event that showcases the city’s creative community with gallery openings, studio visits, live music, vendor markets, and other special programming. For Aug. 7, 2026, featured activities include Artspace’s free First Friday event and the First Friday Market & Movie at Moore Square.

events.name: Tim McGraw: Pawn Shop Guitar Tour 2026
events.tagline: Tim McGraw brings his 2026 summer tour to Raleigh with special guest 49 Winchester.
events.venue: Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek
events.description: Tim McGraw’s Pawn Shop Guitar Tour 2026 stops at Coastal Credit Union Music Park at Walnut Creek in Raleigh on Friday, August 7, 2026. The show is scheduled for 7:00 PM and includes special guest 49 Winchester.

events.name: Movie Night: Pirates of the Caribbean - The Curse of the Black Pearl
events.tagline: A free summer movie night at Downtown Cary Park with family-friendly pre-show activities.
events.description: Downtown Cary Park is hosting a free screening of Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl at the DCP Great Lawn Pavilion on Friday, August 7, 2026. Pre-screening activities begin at 6 p.m., and the movie night is part of the park’s free film series curated by The Cary Theater.

events.name: Sir Walter Miler
events.tagline: A free elite mile race under the lights at Meredith College.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 6:00 PM–late; elite races and related events run in the evening
events.description: The Sir Walter Miler is an annual outdoor one-mile track event held at Meredith College in Raleigh. The 2026 event is scheduled for Friday, August 7, and is free and open to the public.

events.name: First Friday Market & Movie Night: Zootopia 2
events.tagline: Free outdoor movie night with a market, music, and food trucks at Moore Square.
events.description: First Friday Market & Movie Night is a free community event at Moore Square featuring a market, food trucks, live music, games, and an outdoor screening of Zootopia 2. The event is part of a monthly First Friday series presented by Get 2 Know Raleigh and Raleigh Parks.

events.name: PLAYlist Concert Series: Some Of It All
events.tagline: Free Friday-night live music in Durham Central Park.
events.description: PLAYlist is a free outdoor concert series presented by Durham Central Park and WNCU 90.7 FM, held on the first Friday of the month from May through October. This edition features Some Of It All, with DJ music, food and drinks, and a live band set in the park.

events.name: Bands, Bites, and Boats Aug 2026
events.tagline: Free Friday night music, food trucks, and lakefront fun at Bond Park.
events.description: Bands, Bites, and Boats is a free community event at Bond Park Boathouse featuring live music, local food trucks, craft beer, and after-hours boat rentals on Bond Lake. For August 7, 2026, the Town of Cary lists Adam Pitts as the band, with food from Not Just A Fry Guy and Craft Public House and beer from Fortnight Brewing Company.

events.name: First Friday with NC Courage Women’s Pro Soccer Team
events.tagline: Happy hour at the museum with the NC Courage, complete with mini soccer, giveaways, and photos with Roary.
events.description: The City of Raleigh Museum hosts a First Friday happy hour with the NC Courage. Attendees can enjoy drinks, photos with Roary, mini soccer, giveaways, and friendship bracelet activities while celebrating women’s soccer.

events.name: Morrisville Music in the Park 2026
events.tagline: A free Friday night concert with live music and food trucks at Indian Creek Trailhead.
events.description: Morrisville’s Music in the Park is a summer concert series featuring a local band and food trucks at Indian Creek Trailhead. The 2026 event on August 7 runs from 6:30 to 8:30 p.m. and is free to attend.

events.name: Curfew Club
events.tagline: A bedtime-friendly dance party for babes who still want to go hard.
events.description: Curfew Club is a 21+ dance party at Motorco Music Hall featuring DJ Luxe Posh and a mix of house, indie sleaze, pop, hip hop, and disco. The event is presented as a community dance night for people who want to have fun before midnight.

events.name: Dogstar: ALL IN NOW TOUR
events.tagline: Keanu Reeves’ Dogstar brings the All In Now tour to Raleigh for a Friday night set.
events.description: Dogstar, the alternative rock band featuring Keanu Reeves, is scheduled to perform at The Ritz in Raleigh on Friday, August 7, 2026. The show is part of the band's All In Now tour.

events.name: Special Event: Ryan Davis
events.tagline: Stand-up from Charlotte native Ryan Davis at Goodnights Comedy Club.
events.description: Ryan Davis is scheduled for a special event at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh on Friday, August 7, 2026, with shows at 7:00 PM and 9:15 PM. Goodnights lists the event as part of a multi-night run, with Friday through Sunday performances in Room 861.

events.name: Jenny Tian
events.tagline: Jenny Tian brings stand-up to Room 861 at Goodnights Comedy Club.
events.description: Jenny Tian is scheduled to perform stand-up on Friday, August 7, 2026 at Room 861 at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh. Goodnights lists Friday through Sunday shows in Room 861 for this weekend, and the event is 18+.

events.name: Vladimir Caamano
events.tagline: Stand-up comedy from the actor and storyteller known for TV roles and live club sets.
events.description: Vladimir Caamano is scheduled to perform at Raleigh Improv in Raleigh. He is a standup comedian and actor known for recurring roles on NBC's Superstore, Hulu's MARVEL'S Runaways, and CBS's TOMMY.

events.name: Hot Metal Cold Beer
events.tagline: A behind-the-scenes foundry happy hour with live metal casting and local art.
events.scheduleNote: Fri evening; exact time not listed
events.description: Hot Metal Cold Beer is a First Friday event at Liberty Arts in Durham where guests design a bronze or aluminum piece, watch it get cast in a live pour, and enjoy a drink token from The Glass Jug Beer Lab. The August 7 session features a bronze medallion and includes a pop-up art market.

events.name: The Wild Wisdom of the World | Paperhand Puppet Project
events.tagline: A giant outdoor puppet spectacle of masks, music, and illuminated creatures.
events.description: Paperhand Puppet Project’s 26th annual summer production features giant puppets, masks, shadows, stilts, and live original music at the open-air Forest Theatre. The 2026 run is scheduled on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays from August 7 through September 27.

events.name: 2026 NASCAR Regional Season - Delta Heating & Cooling 165
events.tagline: Friday-night short-track racing at Raleigh’s “America’s Favorite Bullring.”
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7–11 PM; green flag at 8:30 PM
events.description: NASCAR Regional racing returns to Wake County Speedway for the Delta Heating & Cooling 165. The event features stock car racing action at the Raleigh short track, with qualifying and racing on Friday night.

events.name: Blue Light Basement Party
events.tagline: A retro-funk basement party with DJs, games, and a best-dressed cash prize.
events.description: A 1983-themed party at the Durham Armory featuring two DJs playing funk, R&B, disco, and soul. The event also includes table games, a Soul Train scramble board, and a cash prize for the best dressed attendee.

events.name: First Friday Latin Nights!
events.tagline: Dance to DJ Synko’s Latin beats on a rooftop in downtown Durham.
events.description: Monthly First Friday dance night at The Velvet Hippo featuring DJ Synko and a mix of reggaeton, bachata, merengue, Latin house, dembow, cumbia, and more. The event is held at The Velvet Hippo Bar & Lounge in downtown Durham and is free to attend for guests 21 and older.

events.name: The Move First Friday Dance Party with DJ Jermainia
events.tagline: A monthly First Friday dance party with funk, pop, and disco at Bitter Social.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 9 PM–1 AM; doors at 7 PM
events.description: Recurring monthly First Friday dance party at Bitter Social in downtown Raleigh featuring DJ Jermainia. The event runs from 9 PM to 1 AM, with doors opening at 7 PM.

events.name: Connor Lee Quartet & Alamance Jazz Collective
events.tagline: A Friday night jazz set at Slim's Dive Bar.
events.description: Connor Lee Quartet performs at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh, featuring Alamance Jazz Collective. The event is scheduled for Friday, August 7, 2026, from 9:00 to 11:00 PM.

events.name: Luther S. Allison Sextet
events.tagline: A high-energy jazz sextet led by acclaimed multi-instrumentalist Luther S. Allison.
events.description: Luther S. Allison Sextet performs at The Durham Jazz Workshop/Sharp 9 Gallery on Friday, August 7 at 7:00 PM. The listing names Luther Allison on piano and notes a ticketed jazz concert with student and adult admission.

events.name: An Evening with Mason Via
events.tagline: An intimate Friday night set from Mason Via at Wake Forest Listening Room.
events.description: Mason Via performs at The Wake Forest Listening Room in downtown Wake Forest on Friday, August 7, 2026. The event is listed as all-ages with doors at 6:45 PM and showtime at 7:30 PM.

events.name: Artist Notes featuring Joseph Terrell
events.tagline: An intimate free summer evening of live music and storytelling at Centennial Campus.
events.venue: The Corner at NC State’s Centennial Campus
events.description: Artist Notes is a free storyteller concert series at The Corner on NC State’s Centennial Campus, featuring Joseph Terrell of Mipso on Friday, August 7. The event includes live music, food trucks, free parking, and welcomes camp chairs, leashed dogs, and coolers with beer or wine.

events.name: Lords of Lightning with Locally Sourced Weaponry and The Phuzz Band
events.tagline: Three local acts bring an all-ages indie rock night to Local 506.
events.description: An all-ages live music show at Local 506 featuring Lords of Lightning, Locally Sourced Weaponry, and The Phuzz Band. The venue lists doors at 7 pm and showtime at 8 pm.

events.name: Amateur Talent Show
events.tagline: First Friday talent competition with a late-night club crowd.
events.freeNote: Free before 10 PM; $5 for 21+, $10 for ages 18-20
events.description: A recurring First Friday Amateur Talent Show at Legends Nightclub in downtown Raleigh, hosted by Chloe Cassidy. The event starts late at night on the club floor and is open to both performers and spectators.

events.name: SLUTFEST 2026
events.tagline: A two-night metal festival returns to Chapel of Bones.
events.description: SLUTFEST 2026 is a two-day festival at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh, with the weekend opening on Friday, August 7, 2026. Listings describe it as a recurring metal-focused event with doors at 3 PM and tickets required.

events.name: The Big Three Tour: Mocktallica / Hell Awaits / Tornado of Souls
events.tagline: Three metal tributes, one high-voltage night in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: The Big Three Tour features tribute acts Mocktallica, Hell Awaits, and Tornado of Souls performing the music of Metallica, Slayer, and Megadeth. It is scheduled for Friday, August 7, 2026 at KINGS in Raleigh.

events.name: Eno Arts Mill Grand Re-Opening
events.tagline: A free Friday evening celebration with live music, open studios, art-making, and food and drinks for purchase.
events.description: The Eno Arts Mill Grand Re-Opening on Friday, August 7, 2026, runs from 6-9 PM and features live music by Liquid Pleasure, open artist studios, local food trucks, and free art-making activities for all ages. The event also includes gallery exhibitions by Eno Arts Mill studio artists impacted by Tropical Storm Chantal.

events.name: West Side Story
events.tagline: A classic musical of love and rivalry takes the stage in Raleigh.
events.description: West Side Story is listed as a theatrical performance at Stars Auditorium at IMAGINX in Raleigh. The newsletter listing indicates a Friday showing for the weekend of 2026-08-07.

events.name: Charles Esten
events.tagline: A live concert from actor-musician Charles Esten at Bowstring Pizza and Brewyard.
events.description: Charles Esten is scheduled to perform at Bowstring Pizza and Brewyard in Raleigh on Friday, August 7, 2026. Doors open at 6 PM, and the show runs from 7 PM to 10 PM.

events.name: Friday Bourbon Release Dinner
events.tagline: An intimate bourbon tasting and chef-led dinner in downtown Cary.
events.description: Peck & Plume is hosting a Friday Bourbon Release Dinner on August 7 with a guided tasting of its three Maker’s Mark Private Selection bourbons, followed by a four-course dinner with beverage pairings. The event begins at 6 PM in the restaurant’s new outdoor space and continues in the Redbud Room.

events.name: Clue (High School Edition)
events.tagline: A madcap murder mystery packed with suspects, secrets, and laughs.
events.description: Raleigh Little Theatre presents Clue (High School Edition) as part of its Teens on Stage and Teens Backstage program. The production runs July 24 to August 9, 2026 in the Gaddy-Goodwin Teaching Theatre with performances on Fridays and Saturdays at 7:30 PM and Sundays at 3:00 PM.

events.name: Artist/Curatorial Discussion with Sam van Strien
events.tagline: A free First Friday discussion around Sam van Strien’s work in Artspace’s Upfront Gallery.
events.description: Free artist/curatorial discussion at Artspace’s First Friday event, tied to Sam van Strien’s work in the Upfront Gallery. Downtown Raleigh’s First Friday listing places the Artspace programming on Friday, August 7, with the discussion at 4 pm.

events.name: Stephen Wilson Jr. - Raleigh
events.tagline: Stephen Wilson Jr. brings the Gary The Torch Tour to Red Hat Amphitheater with The Lone Bellow.
events.description: Stephen Wilson Jr. is scheduled to perform at Red Hat Amphitheater in Raleigh on Saturday, August 8, 2026, at 7:00 PM, with The Lone Bellow listed as the special guest. The venue is an open-air amphitheater in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Bronco - El Gran Baile Tour
events.tagline: Bronco brings its 2026 El Gran Baile Tour to Raleigh for a Saturday night concert.
events.venue: Memorial Auditorium at Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Bronco's El Gran Baile Tour is scheduled for Saturday, August 8, 2026 at Raleigh Memorial Auditorium, with doors opening at 7:00 PM and the show starting at 8:00 PM. The event is part of the Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts calendar in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Rhythm & Reels - Concerts
events.tagline: Free live music under the stars at Apex Nature Park Amphitheatre.
events.description: Rhythm & Reels is Apex’s free summer concert-and-movie series held on select Saturday evenings at Nature Park Amphitheatre. Concerts begin at 7:00 PM, with movies shown at dusk on other dates in the series.

events.name: Dom Flemons Presents the Bronze Buckaroo Film and Songster Show
events.tagline: A multimedia tribute to Black cowboy history and roots music.
events.description: Dom Flemons’s Bronze Buckaroo Film and Songster Show blends live music, film, and history to celebrate the legacy of Black cowboys and Black roots music. The program pairs songs from Flemons’s Black Cowboys album with scenes from the 1939 film The Bronze Buckaroo, along with stories and originals from Traveling Wildfire.

events.name: GIANT ROBOT FIGHT CLUB
events.tagline: A cardboard robot battle royale with prizes, chaos, and comedy.
events.description: GIANT ROBOT FIGHT CLUB is a live comedy battle show where performers wear homemade cardboard robot suits and fight for audience applause, prizes, and bragging rights. The Durham show is scheduled at Motorco Music Hall on Saturday at 8 PM.

events.name: NC Jerk Festival
events.tagline: A free, family-friendly celebration of Jamaican independence with live music, food, and culture.
events.description: The North Carolina Jerk Festival is a free, family-friendly celebration of Jamaican independence at Durham Central Park. It features live music, food vendors, a beer garden, arts and crafts vendors, and kids’ activities.

events.name: Native American Film Festival
events.tagline: A day of Native stories told through films, shorts, and documentaries.
events.description: The Triangle Native American Society presents the 2nd Annual Triangle Native American Film Festival at The Rialto Theatre. The program includes animated shorts, PBS documentaries, and full-length films, with VIP tickets offering indigenous cuisine by Atkowa Catering.

events.name: August Market on the Videri Patio
events.tagline: A Saturday patio market featuring local makers at Videri Chocolate Factory.
events.description: Videri Chocolate Factory is hosting its August market on the patio in downtown Raleigh. The event page lists local vendors and places it on Saturday, August 8, 2026.

events.name: First Responders Day
events.tagline: Touch-a-truck, train rides, and a salute to local first responders.
events.freeNote: Adults $16.45; Seniors 60+ $15.37; Children 2–12 $13.20; Children under 2 free
events.description: First Responders Day at New Hope Valley Railway features emergency vehicles from local fire, police, and EMS agencies, plus a Touch-a-Truck experience. Scenic train rides are scheduled during the event, making it a family-friendly community outing.

events.name: The Revolutionists
events.tagline: A sharp, funny French Revolution comedy about art, resistance, and legacy.
events.description: Written by Lauren Gunderson, The Revolutionists runs at Theatre In The Park as part of its 2026 mainstage season. The play follows four fierce women in the middle of the French Revolution as they grapple with art, revolution, and what it means to leave a legacy.

events.name: Science Today: Intro to Bacteria
events.tagline: An interactive science program exploring the microscopic world of bacteria.
events.venue: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
events.description: A science-focused event introducing bacteria and what they are. Bacteria are microscopic single-celled organisms found in many environments, including on and in the human body.

events.name: Repticon 2026
events.tagline: A weekend reptile and exotic animal expo at the NC State Fairgrounds.
events.venue: Agri Supply Exposition Center at North Carolina State Fairgrounds
events.scheduleNote: Sat 10:00 AM–5:00 PM · Sun 10:00 AM–4:00 PM
events.description: Repticon Raleigh is a reptile and exotic animal expo featuring live animals, vendors, supplies, and educational seminars. It is scheduled for August 8–9, 2026 at the North Carolina State Fairgrounds in Raleigh.

events.name: Bright Black's 7th Birthday!
events.tagline: Bright Black celebrates seven years of scent, stories, and Black brilliance.
events.description: Bright Black is hosting a birthday celebration at its Durham showroom with free admission and special in-store festivities. The event marks seven years of the Black-owned scent brand and runs during regular Saturday showroom hours.

events.name: Hayti Business Expo
events.tagline: A free Black business expo celebrating local entrepreneurs and community.
events.description: The Hayti Business Expo is a collaborative event between Hayti Heritage Center and local Black-owned businesses to showcase and sell products. It features more than 80 vendors offering items such as food, apparel, and trinkets.

events.name: Will Campbell Sextet
events.tagline: Live jazz at Durham’s Sharp 9 Gallery.
events.description: A jazz performance by the Will Campbell Sextet at Sharp 9 Gallery in Durham. The Durham Jazz Workshop lists the concert as part of its upcoming schedule at the venue.

events.name: Les Trois Chats — Hot Club Jazz
events.tagline: A Saturday night of gypsy jazz and hot club swing at Succotash.
events.description: Les Trois Chats is listed as a hot club jazz performance at Succotash Southern and Creole Kitchen in Durham. Succotash’s event listings and social page indicate it hosts live music on Saturday nights, and similar Durham listings for the venue are free admission.

events.name: Jack The Songman
events.tagline: An album-release show with special guests at Cat's Cradle Back Room.
events.description: Jack The Songman is scheduled for an album-release show at Cat's Cradle Back Room in Carrboro on Friday, August 7, 2026, with Laura Ivy and Pint Night opening. The show is listed for 8:00 PM.

events.name: Speakeasy’s Queer Cabaret and Dance Party (is turning TWO!)
events.tagline: A queer cabaret, trivia, and late-night dance party celebrating two years at Speakeasy.
events.description: Speakeasy’s Queer Cabaret and Dance Party is a recurring LGBTQ+ nightlife event in Carrboro featuring trivia, a drag cabaret, and a dance party. The event listing for this weekend describes it as a two-year celebration at Speakeasy, starting at 7 PM and running late into the night.

events.name: Band Together & Cardinal Talent Group Live present: Young Gun Silver Fox - Band Together Silver Summer Homecoming Show
events.tagline: Band Together’s 2nd Annual Silver Summer Homecoming brings Young Gun Silver Fox to The Pour House.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: Band Together and Cardinal Talent Group Live present Young Gun Silver Fox for the second annual Silver Summer Homecoming event at The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop in Raleigh. The listing notes VIP tickets include primo viewing, food, and two drink tickets for beer or wine, with VIP limited to ages 21+.

events.name: Barstool Rodeo: Celebrating the Life & Music of Michael Houser
events.tagline: A tribute night honoring Michael Houser and classic Widespread Panic-era setlists.
events.description: Barstool Rodeo is a musical tribute to Widespread Panic’s original lead guitarist, Michael Houser. The show recreates classic Widespread Panic setlists from the 1990s and early 2000s.

events.name: In Rotation with Justin Bodega & Friends
events.tagline: A rotating Saturday night set blending local sounds and guest DJs in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: An event titled "In Rotation with Justin Bodega & Friends" at Bitter Social in Raleigh. The listing indicates a Saturday occurrence during the week of 2026-08-07.

events.name: Red Bird Mystery Dinner: “Betting on Death”
events.tagline: An interactive murder mystery dinner where guests help solve the case.
events.description: A murder mystery dinner at Red Bird in downtown Raleigh, presented as an interactive evening of dining and intrigue. The venue is Red Bird’s event space at the Residence Inn Raleigh Downtown.

events.name: Sid Simmons & Lawn Enforcement
events.tagline: A live music set at Slim’s Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Sid Simmons & Lawn Enforcement is listed as a live music event at Slim’s Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh. Slim’s is a neighborhood bar and live music venue at 227 S Wilmington St.

events.name: Money Shot with Tiger Knives
events.tagline: A Saturday night of dirty funky disco rock and darkwave/post-punk at Local 506.
events.description: Money Shot with Tiger Knives is an all-ages show at Local 506 in Chapel Hill featuring Money Shot and Tiger Knives. Local 506 lists doors at 7 pm and showtime at 8 pm on Saturday, August 8.

events.name: Argo and the Violet Queens // Dr. Shug // Lennon KC // Alaska’s Angels
events.tagline: A Saturday night lineup of psych-rock and indie acts at Neptunes Parlour.
events.description: Argo and the Violet Queens, Dr. Shug, Lennon KC, and Alaska’s Angels are scheduled to perform at Neptunes Parlour in downtown Raleigh. The event listing shows doors at 7 PM and showtime at 8 PM with a $10 cover.

events.name: Surprise Group Show at Lump
events.tagline: A surprise group art exhibition at Lump in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Lump is a contemporary art space in downtown Raleigh at 505 S Blount St. Its gallery events page lists exhibitions and open hours, and Visit Raleigh identifies Lump as a free venue in the same location.

events.name: Rainbow 6 Siege LAN Tournament
events.tagline: A local Rainbow Six Siege LAN showdown at EgoChall Esports.
events.description: An in-person Rainbow Six Siege LAN tournament held at EgoChall Esports in Chapel Hill. EgoChall lists Rainbow Six Siege monthly LAN events with PC, single-elimination play, and entry fees for solo players or full teams.

events.name: An Unexpected Crafting Party: Origami Dragons
events.tagline: A themed craft night where fans can learn to fold their own origami dragon.
events.scheduleNote: Sat evening alongside the 4 PM prerelease event
events.description: An Unexpected Crafting Party is a casual, creative in-store activity tied to The Hobbit prerelease weekend at The Gathering Place. The listing says participants can learn to make their own origami dragon at the bar.

events.name: Lanza's Cafe 5th Birthday Party!
events.tagline: A birthday bash with live music, magic, and cafe fun.
events.description: Lanza's Cafe in Carrboro is hosting its 5th birthday party with live music and magic. The event is listed for Saturday, August 8, and is part of the cafe's events calendar.

events.name: 76th Street w/ Tornsey
events.tagline: An indie-pop night with 76th Street and Tornsey at The Pour House.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: 76th Street performs with Tornsey at The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop in Raleigh. The show is scheduled for Sunday, August 9, 2026, with doors at 7:00 PM and music at 8:00 PM.

events.name: Glitter Hour - Amateur Drag Competition
events.tagline: An amateur drag showdown where performers compete for bragging rights and a monthly win.
events.description: Glitter Hour is a monthly amateur drag competition featuring performers of all styles and experience levels. The event is held at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh and is open to ages 18+.

events.name: Serving Brunch: Burlesque & Drag
events.tagline: A theatrical Sunday brunch with burlesque, drag, food, and cocktails.
events.freeNote: General Admission $12; Brunch add-on $15; VIP table for 2 $70
events.description: Groovy Tomb Productions presents a burlesque brunch featuring live performances, brunch favorites, coffee, and cocktails in a lively theatrical setting. The event takes place at Chapel of Bones in Raleigh and offers general admission, brunch add-on, and VIP table options.

events.name: Jason Adamo Presents North Carolina Songwriters in the Round Featuring 8 NC Artists
events.tagline: An intimate evening of North Carolina songwriters sharing songs and stories in the round.
events.description: Jason Adamo presents North Carolina Songwriters in the Round at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh. The show features eight North Carolina artists performing in an intimate songwriter-in-the-round format, with doors at 5 PM and showtime at 6 PM.

events.name: Mac and Me
events.tagline: A retro family favorite returns to the big screen in downtown Cary.
events.description: Part of The Cary Theater’s Summer Family Series, this screening of the 1980s sci-fi family film Mac and Me takes place on Sunday, August 9, 2026 at noon. The series features Sunday matinee retro films through the summer.

events.name: Notes on View: Eduardo de Rosamaria
events.tagline: Free gallery concerts inspired by the art on view at NCMA.
events.description: Notes on View is a pop-up performance series at the North Carolina Museum of Art featuring 40-minute live concerts in the galleries. This edition features guitarist Eduardo de Rosamaria (Edward Stephenson), with performances designed to respond to works on display.

events.name: Prabhu Deva
events.tagline: Prabhu Deva brings a high-energy live dance concert to Raleigh.
events.venue: Raleigh Memorial Auditorium at Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Prabhu Deva - Live Dance Concert is scheduled for Sunday, August 9, 2026 at Raleigh Memorial Auditorium in Raleigh. The event page describes it as a cinematic dance experience featuring Prabhu Deva, signature choreography, and 100+ local dancers.

events.name: Raleigh Comic Book Show
events.tagline: An old-school comic book sale with free admission and longtime dealers.
events.description: The Raleigh Comic Book Show is a comic book show and sale at the Hilton Garden Inn Raleigh/Crabtree Valley. Visit Raleigh lists the 2026 date as August 9, with free admission and show hours from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.

events.name: Stephens Pharmacy
events.tagline: A live set at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Stephens Pharmacy is listed on Slim's Dive Bar's calendar for Sunday, August 9, 2026, at 7:00 PM in downtown Raleigh. The venue is a live-music bar at 227 S Wilmington St.

events.name: Steve Hofstetter & Friends
events.tagline: Steve Hofstetter brings his sharp stand-up to Goodnights for a Sunday night show.
events.description: A stand-up comedy show featuring Steve Hofstetter & Friends at Goodnights Comedy Club in Raleigh. The event is listed for Sunday, August 9, 2026 at 7:30 PM and is 18+.

events.name: Theater Book Club Presents: A reading of Red Speedo written by Lucas Hnath
events.tagline: A staged reading of Lucas Hnath’s sharp Olympic-doping drama.
events.description: Theater Book Club presents a reading of Red Speedo, a full-length drama by Lucas Hnath about a swimmer on the eve of Olympic trials whose future is threatened by a performance-enhancing-drugs scandal. The listing places the event at The Green Room in Raleigh.

events.name: 2026 Summer Concert Series
events.tagline: A free Sunday evening concert series at Fred Fletcher Park featuring local live music.
events.description: The City of Raleigh’s Summer Concert Series offers free live performances on select Sunday evenings at Fred Fletcher Park and Pullen Park. For Fred Fletcher Park, attendees are asked to bring their own food and beverages, and the concerts run from 6 to 8 p.m.

events.name: Raleigh Underground Market
events.tagline: A free Sunday market with local vendors, live music, food trucks, and drinks at Midtown Park.
events.description: Raleigh Underground Market is a monthly market and concert series at Midtown Park in North Hills featuring 50+ local vendors, live bands, workshops, and food trucks. It is held on the second Sunday of the month and is free to attend.

events.name: Tea on Tenth: Rooftop Afternoon Tea at 10th & Terrace
events.tagline: A Sunday rooftop afternoon tea with city views, specialty teas, and light bites.
events.venue: 10th & Terrace at Residence Inn Raleigh Downtown
events.description: Tea on Tenth is a Sunday rooftop afternoon tea at 10th & Terrace in downtown Raleigh. The experience includes curated teas, scones, cakes, pastries, and city views, with alcoholic beverages available.

events.name: Roaming Readers: Historical Fiction
events.tagline: A lakeside audiobook walk through historical fiction in RTP.
events.description: Roaming Readers is an audiobook club with a walking format at Hub RTP. This edition focuses on historical fiction and takes place at Horseshoe at Hub RTP in Durham.

events.name: Walt Weiskopf NY-DC Connection Quartet
events.tagline: A straight-ahead jazz quartet led by saxophonist Walt Weiskopf.
events.description: Saxophonist, composer, and author Walt Weiskopf leads a quartet featuring Harry Appelman on piano, Amy Shook on bass, and Stefan Schatz on drums. The event is listed for Sharp 9 Gallery in Durham on Sunday at 3:00 PM.

events.name: Cocktail Classes at Durham Distillery
events.tagline: A hands-on Sunday cocktail class with Durham Distillery’s spirits and techniques.
events.description: Durham Distillery offers a 90-minute cocktail class with hands-on instruction and a minimum of 5 guests required for the class to run. The class is scheduled on Sundays from 3:00 to 4:30 PM.

events.name: The Wallflowers
events.tagline: The Wallflowers bring their 30th-anniversary 'Bringing Down the Horse' tour to Durham.
events.description: The Wallflowers perform at the Carolina Theatre in Durham as part of their 30th-anniversary tour celebrating 'Bringing Down the Horse.' The show is scheduled for Sunday, August 9, 2026, at 8:00 PM.

events.name: Bark Culture
